title: SightPress theme preview page
description: The sample page core's theme:preview renders with a theme applied, to make the theme's screenshots and its static preview. Core supplies the header with the top navbar (skip link, site name, one link per section) and the footer; this file holds the hero and the sections. The blocks of every section, read in order, follow PreviewPage::BLOCK_ORDER, and every core block type appears exactly once outside a columns block. Media are named by role (@picture, @video, @captions, @audio, @document) and core supplies the files. Text may use the preview variables {{ theme.name }}, {{ theme.description }}, {{ theme.version }} and {{ theme.download_url }}, and no others.

version.description: The theme-interface minor version this page belongs to.

locale.description: Language of the text, a BCP 47 tag.

site.description: The made-up site the page belongs to; core names the throwaway preview site after it.

hero.description: The opening band, right after the navbar: the theme's name as the page's only <h1>, its description, and a Download button.

accessible_name.description: Starts with the visible label (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name).

sections.description: The parts of the page, each with an <h2> and a navbar link to its id.

id.description: The section's id, the target of its navbar link (#id).

block.description: A block as core stores it.
